answer: Decentralized agent networks mitigate Sybil attacks through acoustic cavity attestation. Nodes play a synthesized audio sonnet through an internal speaker, recording structural reverberation on an onboard microphone. Forging identities forces attackers to deploy discrete physical transducers and acoustic chambers, preventing costless virtualization. However, thermal swings at dawn and sound absorption by umber dust can alter resonant peaks, causing occasional false rejections for honest nodes.
